name: Post Time Survival
format: vertical animated survival story Short (1080x1920, 30 fps), length set by lengthSeconds below
lengthNote: YouTube Shorts may run up to 180 s (3 minutes, since October 2024). This channel allows 70-150 s so a survival story has room for its steps; longer costs more render time and voice. Pick the length the story needs, not the maximum.
voiceNote: The owner chose to reuse the first channel voice for the first film (2026-11-08); the two channels will sound alike until a different voice is chosen and paid for.
descriptionFooter: 🌲 Post Time Survival: original animated survival stories. Subscribe and join our animated survival world!
disclosure: Narration, sound effects and music were made with AI (ElevenLabs). Original story; all events are fiction.
coverStyle: danger frame from the film: the hero's face in the first beat of real danger, the threat visible but not graphic, cold or dusk colours with one warm light; no text, no ring, no vignette, engine depth of field (studio2/library/cover-dof.mjs)
visualFlavour: moody: dusk, night, fog, forest, ruins and tunnels; saturated key colour on the hero against a cool desaturated world; the threat is a silhouette or a shape that is easy to read at 120 px
soundFlavour: tension bed and low drones, sudden stingers only at the danger peaks, silence before the peak, a warm release in the last beat
contentRules: Original stories only; no real disasters, real victims or real people.
Cartoon peril, never gore: no blood, no injury shown, threats are shapes, silhouettes and consequences.
Label fiction as fiction in the description.

Every story: a hero who decides (a named hero, or "you" in a second-person POV film) with a choice beat before the peak, a threat with a rule, a danger ladder that rises, an ending that pays off the rule.
